flora: Multiple Mature Tree Ferns (slender, dark, fibrous trunks; huge spreading crowns of lacy fronds)
Ground ferns and mosses (forming a lush carpet)
Ancient fallen logs covered in moss
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile textures; emphasis on the height and the delicate canopy; lush, humid atmosphere with high visual density of greenery.

visual_logic.composition: An eye-level view looking into a misty, lush grove of tree ferns. The trunks should be staggered to show depth, with their wide fronds overlapping to create a soft 'roof' of greenery over a mossy floor.
visual_logic.ground: A rich, damp forest floor with a thick carpet of green moss and small ground-dwelling ferns.
visual_logic.lighting: Beams of sunlight filtering through a misty canopy (god rays), creating bright highlights on the green fronds and leaving the forest floor in soft, cool shadows.
